scenes.name: THE BROKEN RULER
lines: Tilt a ray toward upright and read its slope: one half, one, two, five, ten.
把一条射线向竖直方向扳，读出斜率：1/2、1、2、5、10。
At upright, Q is zero, and the number crashes: one over zero.
到了竖直位置 Q = 0，这个数当场崩塌：1/0。
The usual fix glues on infinity, a symbol arithmetic refuses.
通常的补救是硬贴一个 ∞，而四则运算并不接纳它。

scenes.name: KEEP THE PAIR
lines: So never divide. Keep two whole numbers, P to Q, and call multiples the same point.
那就不做除法。保留两个整数 P : Q，并把它们的倍数看成同一个点。
Two to four, three to six, minus one to minus two: one point, one to two.
The denominator becomes P squared plus Q squared, never zero; fidelity kappa is Q squared over it.
分母换成 P² + Q²，永不为零；保真度 κ 是 Q² 除以它。
For two to four: sixteen twentieths, four fifths again.
Lean checks that nonzero rescaling, minus one included, leaves kappa unchanged.
Lean 内核检验：任意非零缩放（包括乘以 −1）都不改变 κ。

scenes.name: TWO SHARES
lines: Spread s takes P squared instead: one to two splits into four fifths and one fifth.
展开度 s 改取 P²：[1 : 2] 分成 4/5 与 1/5。
Two to three, into nine and four thirteenths.
Lean checks kappa plus s is one for every nonzero pair: no angle, no root, no pi.
Lean 内核检验：对每个非零整数对，κ + s = 1。没有角度，没有根号，没有 π。

scenes.name: THE CAYLEY CIRCLE
lines: Bend the line into a ring: the Cayley point is Q squared minus P squared, and two P Q, over the sum.
把直线弯成圆环：凯莱像点的坐标是 Q² − P² 与 2PQ，分母都是 P² + Q²。
One to two lands at three fifths, four fifths; two to three at five and twelve thirteenths.
Nine plus sixteen is twenty-five; twenty-five plus one forty-four, one sixty-nine.
Lean checks every nonzero pair lands exactly on the unit circle, no square root needed.
Lean 内核检验：每个非零整数对都分毫不差地落在单位圆上，无需开方。

scenes.name: THREE ANCHORS
lines: Three anchors stand out. Zero to one, the book's past: kappa one, spread zero, at one, zero.
三枚锚点格外醒目。[0 : 1] 是书中的“过去”：κ = 1，s = 0，落在 (1, 0)。
One to one, the present: kappa equals one minus kappa, so both are one half.
[1 : 1] 是“现在”：κ = 1 − κ，于是两者都是 1/2。
One to zero, the future, is the old infinity: its denominator is one, not zero.
[1 : 0] 是“未来”，也就是昔日的无穷大：它的分母是 1，不是 0。
Lean checks: at every P to zero, kappa is zero, spread one, and the point minus one, zero.
Lean 内核检验：在每个 [p : 0] 处，κ = 0，s = 1，像点是 (−1, 0)。

scenes.name: INTEGER TURNS
lines: Points multiply as integer pairs: one to two times one to three is five to five, or one to one.
Norms multiply: five times ten is fifty, five squared plus five squared; Lean checks this for all integers.
范数相乘：5 × 10 = 50 = 5² + 5²；Lean 内核对一切整数检验了这条恒等式。
Arctangent one half plus arctangent one third is pi over four; here, one integer product.
arctan(1/2) + arctan(1/3) = π/4；在这里只是一次整数乘法。
Square one to one: two to zero, the antipode. Square again: back home.
[1 : 1] 自乘得 (2, 0)，即对径点；再自乘，回到家。

scenes.name: FINITE HORIZON
lines: Fix a precision, one over M. At M equal to one, four anchors; at two, eight points.
取定精度 1/M。M = 1 时是四枚锚点；M = 2 时是八个点。
At twelve, one hundred eighty-four, each with exact integer readings.
M = 12 时是 184 个点，每个都带着精确的整数读数。
The book's general count is four times a totient sum.
书中给出的一般计数是 4Φ(M)。
One limit remains: swap the factors and nothing changes. Order needs chapter three.
只剩一道限制：交换因子，乘积纹丝不动。要让次序留下痕迹，得去第三章。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter two.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第二章
